description: Golden corpus for sentiment + theme classification (D.6). 20 anonymized review samples chosen to exercise: each allowed theme at least once, sentiment-vs-stars contradiction handling, empty/short text fallback, multi-theme posts, NEUTRAL boundaries, and mixed-signal confidence.

samples.text: Dr. K and her team are wonderful. Walked in nervous, walked out glowing — the results are exactly what I asked for. Would not trust anyone else.
samples.notes: Unambiguous high-rating with explicit staff + outcome praise.

samples.text: Honestly the most reasonable prices in Brickell for this kind of treatment, and you can tell they don't cut corners. Worth every dollar.
samples.notes: Pricing + value framing in a positive context.

samples.text: The space is gorgeous and so calming. I felt taken care of the moment I sat down on the couch. Soft music, herbal tea, the works.
samples.notes: Aesthetic + sensory comfort, no service mention.

samples.text: Finally found a provider who knows what she's doing. Asked all the right questions, explained the science, and the work shows it.
samples.notes: Single-theme: technical competence.

samples.text: Booked online in two minutes, got a confirmation text right away, and the rescheduling when I had a conflict was just as smooth. Front desk is on top of it.
samples.notes: Booking workflow + responsive communication.

samples.text: Spotless. You can tell they take hygiene seriously — every tool sterilized in front of you, every surface wiped.
samples.notes: Single theme: cleanliness emphasis.

samples.text: Great experience overall. Tiny win: easy free parking right out front, which is rare for this neighborhood.
samples.notes: 4★ positive with parking call-out.

samples.text: Three sessions in and I can already see the difference. Plus the package pricing made it manageable on a budget. Highly recommend.
samples.notes: Multi-theme positive.

samples.text: Treatment was fine, results are okay. Staff was professional but a little impersonal. Probably won't be back but no complaints either.
samples.notes: Classic neutral: not bad, not great. Mixed signals.
Empty text — confidence should be low (~0.2 per prompt) and themes empty.
Two-word neutral with no themes.

samples.text: Did the job but pricier than I expected for what amounted to a 20 minute appointment.
samples.notes: Neutral with a single complaint dimension.

samples.text: Showed up on time for my appointment, was kept waiting 45 minutes with no explanation. Treatment itself was fine but I won't be back.
samples.notes: Single-issue negative review.

samples.text: Front desk woman was incredibly rude. Talked down to me when I asked a basic question about pricing. Walked out before the consultation.
samples.notes: Rude + staff — both should fire.

samples.text: Charged me twice for the same session and it took 6 weeks of emails to get refunded. Treatment was fine but I'll never go back after how billing handled it.
samples.notes: Billing dispute drives the 1★ — treatment quality is parenthetical.

samples.text: Drove an hour for my appointment and they 'couldn't find me in the system.' No apology, no offer to fit me in. Bizarre.
samples.notes: missed_appointment theme — operational failure.

samples.text: Called three times to ask a question about my post-treatment care and never got a callback. For the price, I'd expect them to pick up the phone.
samples.notes: Communication failure — pricing mentioned but theme is comms.

samples.text: Sheets on the treatment bed looked reused. The bathroom hadn't been cleaned in what felt like days. That's a hard no for a place doing skincare.
samples.notes: Cleanliness in a negative context.

samples.text: Worst experience of my life. They lost my appointment, then yelled at me when I complained. Avoid.
samples.notes: 5★ but text strongly contradicts — prompt's UNLESS rule says sentiment follows text.

samples.text: Sorry, meant to give this 5 stars — fat-fingered the rating. Honestly the best aesthetician I've ever seen, results are unreal.
samples.notes: 1★ but explicit correction in text — sentiment follows text.
